thread:
maria: Quick design question — trying to compact the sampling controls into the heatmap header for compact/phone layouts. Sketch here: https://redwood.internal/figma/compact-sampler (preview attached). Thoughts on affordance, discoverability & a11y? jake: I like the space-saver idea. Concern: discoverability. If we hide controls behind a tiny pill, people might miss them. Maybe a micro-badge 'Sampled 10%' with a chevron? :thinking_face: anya: a11y nits: collapsed controls must be keyboard reachable, have aria-expanded state, and announce when the tray opens. Also don’t rely on color alone for density indicators (use patterns/labels). kevin: Copy suggestion: instead of plain 'Sampling' use 'Observed traffic (sampled)' to set expectations. But that’s a bit long for a pill. emi: Product note: we want telemetry when users change sampling — track 'ui.sampling.change' with previous & new pct, and whether preset or custom slider used. sam: Implementation constraints: current heatmap canvas is a layer; we can't embed interactive DOM inside it easily. Option: render the pill in the header overlay (DOM) anchored to heatmap, open a tray panel. Minimal DOM work but avoids canvas hacks. designbot: preview uploaded: compact-sampler-v3.png — https://redwood.design/compact-sampler-v3.png :frame_with_picture: maria: Alternative pattern: inline pill that opens a tray. Tray supports keyboard, mouse, touch, and a swipe-down gesture to close on mobile. Tray holds presets + advanced slider. lisa: QA notes: tray needs a focus trap, focus return to the pill, Escape closes, and screenreader announces 'Sampling tray opened, presets 1%, 5%, 10%'. Also test with NVDA/VoiceOver. anya: also add aria-live polite when the sampling percentage updates and when sampling reduces streaming density (so SR users hear the change). Example snippet:```html
...
``` jake: UX idea — quick presets visible in the pill dropdown: 1%, 5%, 10% and a 'More...' element that opens the slider. Keeps primary flows fast. kevin: Short pill copy options: 'Sampled 10%' or 'Sampling: 10%'. Leaning to 'Sampled 10%' (past-tense reads as current state). sam: Performance question: toggling sampling may require backend to recompute backfill/estimates. We should surface an estimated tokens count in the tray so users understand cost/coverage impact. Emi? emi: Backend can expose an endpoint /sampling/estimate that returns estimated_tokens and expected_latency. We'll stub it first and iterate. Add a minor API contract change to telemetry backlog. maria: Proposed consensus: show pill 'Sampled 10%' in compact heatmap header; on click open an accessible tray with presets (1/5/10) + 'More' -> slider; tray implements focus trap, Escape closes, announce open/close; telemetry fired on changes; backend exposes estimate endpoint. Any blockers? anya: +1. Please add keyboard unit tests and screenreader assertions in the ticket. jake: +1 from design. We'll validate discoverability in next usability pass. maria: I'll update Figma and create ticket RDW-UI-1347 with mocks, accessibility acceptance criteria, and checklist. Thanks all :sparkles:
